First, note the given date: 12-24-1584 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
43 weeks and 4 days = 43 × 7 + 4 = 305 days.  
Subtract 305 days from 1584-12-24.  

1584 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian calendar started 1582 but rule still applies for 1584).  
From 1584-12-24 back 24 days → 1584-11-30.  
Remaining 305 − 24 = 281 days to go back from 1584-11-30.  

November has 30 days, so back 30 more days → 1584-10-31.  
Remaining 281 − 30 = 251 days to go back from 1584-10-31.  

October: 31 days → back 31 → 1584-09-30, remaining 220 days.  
September: 30 days → back 30 → 1584-08-31, remaining 190 days.  
August: 31 days → back 31 → 1584-07-31, remaining 159 days.  
July: 31 days → back 31 → 1584-06-30, remaining 128 days.  
June: 30 days → back 30 → 1584-05-31, remaining 98 days.  
May: 31 days → back 31 → 1584-04-30, remaining 67 days.  
April: 30 days → back 30 → 1584-03-31, remaining 37 days.  
March: 31 days → back 31 → 1584-02-29 (leap year), remaining 6 days.  
February 29: back 6 days → 1584-02-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1584-02-23
